tei:div.tei:p: #!"# ༄༅// mgon po tshogs bdag gi sngags 'grigs bai ro tsa nas ldi ri chos grags la gnang ba bzhugs so//

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma hā kā la siddhi yaṃ du dza dzaḥ nye snying*/ rlung ltar myur ba'i snying pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshogs bdag ltar bsnyen pa'i snying po'o// oṃ badzra yaksha bai ta li hūm̐/ yum bsnyen tshag bar dgu ma'o// oṃ badzra yaksha bai ta li hūm̐ phaṭa dza dzaḥ yum bsnyen tshag bar bcu gnyis pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti shaṃ ka ri siddhi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'dod dngos grub 'byung*/ oṃ ma hā kā la yakṣa bai ta li hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab yum gnyis med/ oṃ ma hā kā la ārya re manta hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar phyogs mgon po/ oṃ ma hā kā la tad shad dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho/ oṃ ma hā kā la me tri ma ru ke ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub/ oṃ ma hā kā la bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ārya dzambha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho/ oṃ ma hā kā la de ba niḥṛ ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub/ oṃ ma hā kā la ru gho ru gha ni ru ghe hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ī sha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsand+ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng*/ oṃ ma hā kā la a dhi pa ti bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og / oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud mgon/ oṃ badzra re ma ti ma bhyo dzaḥ re ma ti/ oṃ ma hā kā la aḥde ba raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha/ oṃ ma hā kā la yaḥya ma raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje/ oṃ ma hā kā la maḥm ma raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma mo/ oṃ ma hā kā la duḥpra ma raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud/ oṃ ma hā kā la ruḥ.a shwa raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ btsan/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsaḥrā dza raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal po/ oṃ ma hā kā la shaḥyaksha raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod sbyin/ oṃ ma hā kā la naḥnā ga raksha hūm̐ phaṭa/ klu/ hūm̐ bhyo aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya dza dzaḥ ma mgon sde brgyad bsdus pa/ oṃ tsaṇḍa gtum po/ ma hā chen po/

kā la ya nag po/ shā sa na bstan pa la/ u pa hā ri ṇi/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ e ṣa a 'di pa/ pashtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ phyi ma'i dus/ i daṃ da yang 'dir/ ratna tra yā ya dkon mchog rin chen gsum la/ a pa kā ri ṇa/ gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ ya ti pra ti dzñā gal te na/ sma ra si ta dā dran par gyis la/ i daṃ duṣṭāṃ che ge mo gdug pa can 'di/ kha kha zo zo/ khā hi khā hi/ zo zhig zo zhig / mā ra mā ra/ sod sod/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zungs zungs/ bandha bandha/ chings chings/ ha na ha na/ snun snun/ da ha da ha/ sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos tshos/ di na me ke na mā ra ya nyi ma gcig gis gsad par mdzod cig/che ge mo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ thun sngags/ chos skyong spyi ltar bsnyen pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu ti ka ma la shrī nag mo ti la bhyo/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la be sha tra ma thums nan/ gser srang bcu drug gi gdams pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la siddhi yaṃ du dza dzaḥ yab kyi 'bod pa'o// oṃ badzra yaksha bai ta li hūm̐ dza dzaḥ yum gyi 'bod pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā la ya dgra bo'i snying la 'byin/ snying la su tri dgra bo'i tsitta rbad/ yab kyi rbad pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā la nṛ thums luṃ thums ril rbad su nṛ dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya rbad/ yab kyi gsad pa'o// oṃ badzra yaksha bai ta li hūm̐/ trag raksha rakmo thums ling*/ snying la 'dus 'dus srog la bring bring shaṃ shaṃ khyer bhyo/ yum gyi rbad pa'o// trag raksha rakmo thums ril rbad/ snying kha la raksha dza dzaḥ trag raksha tsitta shaṃ long*/ snying kha la raksha dza dzaḥ thums ling ri li li bhyo/ ma mo'i gsad pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da kā ya wā ka tsitta dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ thun sngags so// rdzogs so/// /
